title: Vajiram & Ravi — study materials
description: Publisher's resource directory for further reading and practice.
readingTask: Choose a topic after completing its NCERT foundation, then test recall with previous questions.

title: Vajiram — Prelims Quick Revision / Knockout
description: Publisher's annual revision collection, including 2026 Knockout volumes. Follow the publisher's download steps; access requirements may apply.
readingTask: Revise by subject and record why each eliminated option is wrong.

title: Economic Survey 2025–26
description: Official national economic assessment with chapter downloads and statistical tables.
readingTask: Record the year and units for each statistic. Build short notes linking growth, jobs, investment and public policy.

title: Economic Survey 2025–26 — Environment and climate change
description: Chapter 10 of the official Economic Survey.
readingTask: Compare adaptation and mitigation, then prepare one example of financing and one of implementation.

title: Economic Survey 2025–26 — Agriculture and food management
description: Chapter 6 of the official Economic Survey.
readingTask: Build a farm-to-market diagram with production, storage, prices and food distribution; add a Bihar example.

title: Second ARC reports — ethics, governance and administration
description: Official Administrative Reforms Commission report collection. Recommendations are proposals, not automatically current law.
readingTask: Read recommendations selectively; connect each to an administrative problem and a realistic implementation constraint.

title: Constitution of India — official editions
description: Official editions of the constitutional text. Check the edition date when studying amendments.
readingTask: Read the relevant article alongside NCERT explanations and compare powers, exceptions and safeguards.

title: Ministry of Home Affairs — annual reports
description: Official annual reporting on home affairs, with downloadable reports.
readingTask: Extract responsibilities, programmes and dated evidence for a security answer; distinguish achievements from remaining challenges.

title: Bihar Finance Department — Economic Survey and Budget
description: State department portal for Bihar's economic and fiscal publications.
readingTask: Prepare a dated sheet of growth, sector shares, expenditure priorities and district comparisons.

title: Bihar Data Lab — district and state indicators
description: Official Bihar statistics portal for state and district comparisons.
readingTask: Compare districts with matching reference years and definitions, then identify an explanatory geographical or economic factor.

title: Ministry of External Affairs — official statements and updates
description: Primary source for India's official foreign-policy statements.
readingTask: Update country briefs with dated agreements and statements; separate official positions from your own analysis.

title: ePathshala — multilingual NCERT textbooks
description: Official alternative access point for NCERT digital textbooks.
readingTask: Use the class and subject selection to find another edition or language when a chapter link has moved.
